patches.name: Clone ChatGPT (experimental baseline)
patches.description: Separate package with mandatory permission and provider renaming. Authentication is unresolved: this patch does not fix invalid auth request. Do not combine with the universal Clone app patch.

options.description: Unique package for the private-account clone.
Application and launcher name. Unicode and punctuation are supported.
Required: rename custom permissions to avoid installation conflicts.
Required: rename provider authorities to avoid installation conflicts.

patches.name: Preserve ChatGPT login callback (experimental)
patches.description: Keeps the original OAuth redirect URI when cloning. Includes the clone baseline. Login and server acceptance remain unverified. Optional default-off initial browser route and fixed-category auth diagnostics.

options.description: Opt in to fixed phase/error categories under SibblAuthTrace. No credentials, server text, URLs or uploads. Diagnostic only; does not fix login.

Opt in to the existing complete web route from the initial generic welcome or modal login. Keeps silent, social and reauthentication routes. Email/password acceptance and return to this clone remain unverified.
